{{nutritionsummary|⅓ of recipe (125 g)|3|270|78|8.7 g|5.7 g|6 mg|518 mg|44.3 g|4.3 g|14.2 g|3.7 g|1%|6%|2%|4%}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (125 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/4.4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) uncooked brown rice or white [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] 
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Curry Powder|curry powder]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*½ cup ({{convert|60|g|oz|abbr=on|disp=s}}) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]] 
*2 cups (500 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]/1.1 [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]] 
*3 vegetarian or chicken [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|bouillon cubes]]

==Procedure==

#Find a large [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] or [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] which has a lid, and place over medium heat. 
#Add butter then chopped onion to pan. Cook the onion for a couple of minutes until it starts to brown slightly.
#Add curry powder, and stir for a minute.
#Mix in vegetarian bouillon cubes, raisins, rice, and water.
#Put on pan lid and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] until water is absorbed (about 15 minutes).
